Theo Ramirez: Quick follow-up from PM: recurring 503s in embed-pipeline when traffic jumps. Need clear owners for remediation tasks, estimated timelines, and a compact RACI. Also decide if any action should start a short remediation sprint.
Priya Kaur: I'm happy to own the immediate mitigation work (rate-limiter + graceful-degrade path). Can we aim for a hotfix in 5 business days?
Ali Mahmood: I can take the longer-term work on queue-resilience and backpressure. Will draft a design doc and propose a 3-week timeline.
Nia Brooks: I'll handle alert tuning and the postmortem recurring-pattern entry. I'll add a metric for "embed-503-rate-after-burst" and a 15m aggregation alert.
Sam Rodriguez: I'll own rollout automation: canary for Hosted + Dedicated, and a rollback hook tied to error-rate > 1% for 5m.
Theo Ramirez: That split sounds good. Can we create two tickets: INF-9012 for hotfix (Priya), INF-9013 for queue/backpressure (Ali)? Add labels: pm-followup, recurring-incident.
Priya Kaur: Creating INF-9012 now 11: INF-9012 - embed-pipeline graceful-degrade (hotfix). Target: 5bd.
infra-bot: New Jira created by Priya: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-9012 (INF-9012)
Ali Mahmood: Created INF-9013: embed-pipeline queue-resilience. Includes design doc, perf benchmarks, and rollout plan. Target: 3w.
infra-bot: New Jira created by Ali: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-9013 (INF-9013)
Nia Brooks: RACI suggestion: R: Priya (hotfix) / Ali (long-term), A: Theo (pm signoff), C: Sam (rollout infra) + Nia (alerts/metrics), I: Eng-oncall + Customer-success.
Sam Rodriguez: I'll add canary jobs and wire the rollback. Also adding a dashboard tile for the new metric.
Priya Kaur: Hotfix plan (brief): 1) enable graceful-degrade mode when queuing > 200ms, 2) fast-path for cached embeddings, 3) limit concurrency per worker. Will add unit + load tests.
Ali Mahmood: Design note: queue-resilience will include prioritized queues + token-bucket shaping per-tenant. Prefers a 2-stage rollout: internal canary -> beta orgs -> general.
Theo Ramirez: Good. Add checkpoints: end-of-week status, demo after 10 days for hotfix, full rollout sign-off after 3 weeks for INF-9013. If owners are unavailable >4 business days, pass to rotation lead (Sam).
infra-bot: Labels updated: INF-9012, INF-9013 tagged with "pm-followup" and "recurring-incident"
Nia Brooks: I'll update the recurring-incident tracker with the observed pattern: spike window correlates with autoscaler event + cold cache. Adding note: test to capture cold-start hit-rate.
Priya Kaur: Small log snippet I'll paste to INF-9012: ```
[2026-03-20T14:02:11Z] WARN embed-queue: latency=285ms queue_len=214 errors=0
[2026-03-20T14:02:12Z] ERROR embed-handler: status=503 reason=queue-overflow
```
Ali Mahmood: Thanks. I'll add that to the design doc as the failure mode sample.
Theo Ramirez: Final owner map: Priya (INF-9012), Ali (INF-9013), Nia (alerts + tracker), Sam (canary + rollback). Please assign Jira assignees and put tentative due dates.
Priya Kaur: Assigned INF-9012 to myself and set due date +5bd.
Ali Mahmood: Assigned INF-9013 to myself, due in 3w.
Nia Brooks: Added alert and dashboard tiles, and linked both tickets in the recurring-incident tracker.
Sam Rodriguez: Scheduling canaries this Thu for hotfix once Priya has a test build. Will add automated rollback if error-rate spikes.
Theo Ramirez: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in 48h for a short sync. Post short updates in this thread and link PRs. Ping me @Theo if blocked. :white_check_mark:
